sentence: The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). The Senator from Massachusetts.

The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). Pursuant to rule XXII, the Chair  lays before the Senate the pending cloture motion, which the clerk will  state.

The senior assistant legislative clerk read as follows:…
The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). The majority leader.

The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). The yeas are 51, the nays are  43, and the motion is agreed to.

The motion was agreed to.
The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). The Senator from California.
The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). Without objection, it is so  ordered.
The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). The Senator from New Hampshire.
The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). The Senator from Louisiana.

The Senator from Louisiana.

The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). Without objection, it is so  ordered.               Unanimous Consent Agreement--Executive Calendar

The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). All time was yielded back.…

The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). On this vote, the yeas are 60,  the nays are 39. The motion is agreed to.

The motion was agreed to.

The PRESIDING OFFICER (Mr. Justice). Under the previous order, the  motion to reconsider is considered made and laid upon the table, and  the President will be immediately notified of the Senate's action.
